# T016 implementation evidence

Final implementation and browser results appear in the completion sections below. Earlier stop notes remain dated execution history.

## Owner amendment, 2026-11-18

English: Sirawise / SIRAWISE. Arabic: سيراوايز. Primary domain: sirawise.io. Default sender: `Sirawise <noreply@sirawise.io>`. Preserve explicit sender overrides and loopback origins. Preserve existing artwork bytes and geometry. New S/س artwork is deferred. The local synthetic demo is in scope. DNS, redirects, sender activation, A01–A16 and Figma changes remain gated.

## Inventory method

Scan tracked UTF-8 text, excluding environment files at every depth and binary files. Match occurrences, including multiple matches per line. UP identifies upstream presentation. EN, JOIN, KEBAB, AR and ARSHORT identify original spellings. Generated inventory rows are excluded from subsequent scans to prevent self-reference. Baseline and final locations are recorded per occurrence.

## Documents compact-library redesign (2026-11-18)

Requirements: B-C05/B-C08/B-C09/B-C10/B-C13. Preserve A04/A06/A07/A08/A10/A12/A13 without new release approval. S17 live desktop metadata/render inspected: https://www.figma.com/design/K3UTevGCFBhsoSLXH7BDni?node-id=21-325. Mobile metadata inspected: https://www.figma.com/design/K3UTevGCFBhsoSLXH7BDni?node-id=41-2. Recovery inventory follows the plan, including empty 52:1182/52:8037, long titles 487:26086/487:26655 and EN 64:164/65:1010; these recovery renders were not refreshed.
Task 1: measurement spec prepared. Baseline, samples, traces and medians deferred to final browser run by owner speed rule. No speed claim.
Task 2: compact template/locale/accent, saved letter state and authorized application stage use two list projections. Latest sent version orders by createdAt and id descending. Focused API tests: 16 pass, including five real-database cases with forced RLS plus privileged-fixture predicate assertions. No document bodies returned. Existing pg concurrency deprecation warning remains.
D36: compact vector identity removes PDF work and reserves card space for saved names and application context.
Task 3: 23 focused web tests pass. PDF/raster spies remain untouched; letter metadata needs no query provider or per-card document/history/words requests. Shared icon-lg supplies the 44px menu. User content keeps dir=auto and complete focus tooltip. Removed only unused library thumbnail runtime/tests after consumer search.
D36: All-only Type cells retain mixed-list identification and remove repeated information from filtered lists.
D36: mobile Name includes saved language/status, application stage and edited time, so the All Type column stays visible without crowding a separate date column.
Task 4: 36 focused web tests pass. Header and row use the same All condition; single-type lists contain no type marker. Existing search/sort tests pass. Rendered breakpoint acceptance remains deferred.
D36: compact skeletons match loaded cards while cached results and distinct recovery actions remain usable.
Task 5: shared skeleton tests 3 pass and loading/recovery tests 13 pass. One accessible localized loading announcement replaces duplicate count announcements. Cached cards and search survive failed refresh, and Retry works. Existing career placeholders remain unchanged.
Task 6: browser specs prepared and format/lint pass. Functional cases, AR/EN grid/list/dialog/recovery screenshots, shell specs, mock comparisons, load samples and sequential live detector calls remain deferred to the final browser run. No clean detector result or browser pass is claimed.

Task 7: final focused runs pass 19 card/dialog tests and 21 card/letter tests after review corrections. Counts overlap earlier runs. Changed-file format/lint pass. Removed seven obsolete preview token allowances and reused existing saved-color fixtures. Package boundaries pass across 2372 files and 23 packages. Roadmap checker reports 0 errors. One static invocation stopped at formatting. Earlier copy-deck/active-surfaces formatting, ATS translator types, ATS typography, GuideText export, and disclosure lint findings remain outside this work. Documents findings are corrected. No full unit or browser suite ran.

Final Impeccable code review and separate self-review cover all five plan risks through API/component evidence. Visual review remains blocked: the separate headless connection closed after sign-in before either permitted AR screenshot. No screenshots, rendered layout pass, detector pass, or timing comparison are claimed. All browser plan steps remain deferred to the final browser run. No release gate receives new approval.

## Application detail redesign, 2026-11-18

Implemented the eight plan tasks inline, in order. The task ledger records each checkpoint without a commit. Owner speed rules replace browser execution, detector runs, workspace-wide units, and the full screenshot matrix. Unticked acceptance items remain visible in the plan.

Requirements: B-C13, B-C10, B-C09 and A13. No schema, route, status model, feature gate, payment, inference, or saved document language changed.

- Shared record headers keep the title and menu together. RecordLayout uses one main column and a 320px rail. Stable keyed panels retain drafts across breakpoints.
- Properties preserve salary strings, contacts, tags, source and revision guards. Recognized SAR ranges use one approved vector and an isolated numeric range.
- One stage select replaces the strip. Closed records retain their reasons, with an explicit missing-reason label. Close failure retains its selected reason until acknowledgement.
- The compact next action selects an ongoing interview first, then the earliest dated action. Saved interview zones and real ICS downloads remain available. D39 keeps preparation gated.
- One composer retains separate legacy-note and timeline-note services. Durable drafts retain owner, revision and storage-generation guards. Delayed responses cannot update another owner’s cache.
- Activity preserves every event, protects its current-stage anchor, promotes one upcoming interview and avoids ambiguous transition origins. Note bodies use automatic direction.
- Sent rows fetch exact snapshot metadata and preserve version links after reopening. One manager stages associations and uploads until Save. Failed saves retain selections.
- Cached refresh failure preserves visible content and blocks writes, including portal actions and legacy autosave. The retained workspace component export uses the same composer.

### Actual results

Focused component and unit tests pass. The last recovery/property/action run passes 27 cases. The legacy/composer run passes 13 cases. The document/manager/version-picker run passes 11 cases. The activity/calendar run passes 8 cases. Earlier salary, SAR, chronology and layout runs also pass. These counts overlap and are not a total.

Scoped AR/EN catalog bindings pass their dedicated unit test for 64 strings. A13 Arabic review remains open. Two broader localization suites fail outside this scope: 217 earlier CV-review copy bindings and 12 untranslated ATS translator messages. Those files remain untouched.

Browser specifications are written for geometry, language preservation, composer persistence, stage changes, close/reopen, filters and exact CV snapshots. Existing board, tracking and version selectors are updated. No browser specification or live detector ran. No workspace-wide unit suite ran.

Live Figma metadata confirms S34 desktop `38:3466`, mobile `49:2096`, and interview state `258:34565`. Live Figma renders and adjacent recovery renders were not refreshed. The approved archived mock remains the redesign reference under D36.

Exactly two screenshots use a separately launched headless Chrome through its private pipe. No owner browser, debugging port, Playwright command, server reset, or demo reset was used. The existing demo record remained unchanged.

- Arabic desktop, 1440×1024: `/tmp/application-detail-visual/ar-SA-1440.png`.
- English phone, 390×844: `/tmp/application-detail-visual/en-US-390.png`.
- Initial geometry: `/tmp/application-detail-visual/metrics.json`. Final geometry: `/tmp/application-detail-visual/metrics-after-fix.json`.

Impeccable source review and both screenshot reviews compared hierarchy, rail placement, composer, disclosure, title/menu alignment and next-action density against the archived AR desktop and EN phone mocks. The phone capture exposed squeezed next-action text. Both captures exposed the menu aligned with Back. Shared fixes now give the phone text the full row and place navigation above the title/action row. Focused tests pass after these fixes. No extra screenshot was taken.

Final geometry reads show no horizontal overflow, equal header/body start edges, menu/title top offset 0px, desktop rail 320px, sidebar 236px and toolbar 64px.
